stage0078_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$シゲル$$
「All EVA units are in position.」

stage0078_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$マコト$$
「Still time before the Angel shows up...」

stage0078_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ミサト$$
「It's fine, it's fine.
　This too is part of the plan.」

stage0078_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$キャシー$$
「They've gone to encourage each EVA pilot.」

stage0078_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「In this operation, what we can do is limited.
　But that's a worthy fight too.」

stage0078_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$田中司令$$
「In that case, allow $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ to fall back...」

stage0078_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
（I'm counting on you, children of EVA...）

stage0078_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$, $$レイ#333$$... are you ready?」

stage0078_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$リツコ$$
（There's no basis for that at all.）

stage0078_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ミサト$$
（What we need right now isn't logical backing,
　but strong will.）

stage0078_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ミサト$$
（For better or worse, ten more minutes...
　That's when it's decided.）

stage0078_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$マコト$$
「Unknowns approaching $$第３新東京市$$ from above!」

stage0078_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$シゲル$$
「This signature!
　It's not an Angel!」

stage0078_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「At a time like this...!」

stage0078_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$田中司令$$
「The fact that Prince $$グーラ$$ isn't here
　means $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ sent the army
　directly himself, I'd wager.」

stage0078_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「You said you'd pull back before Mycenae,
　but it seems you still have lingering
　feelings for Earth.」

stage0078_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$渓$$
「Hold on a second!
　If that Angel thing falls, the world's over, isn't it?!」

stage0078_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$凱$$
「Getting an Earth left in that state,
　is that really fine with $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$?!」

stage0078_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$號$$
「What he wants is this planet itself, I'd guess.」

stage0078_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Operation continues!
　$c, all units, please launch!」

stage0078_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「All right!
　Leave this to us, $$シンジ$$!」

stage0078_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We'll take on $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s army!」

stage0078_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$タケル$$
「EVA, focus on facing the Angel!」

stage0078_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$シモン$$
「So you can fight at full strength,
　we'll give it everything we've got!」

stage0078_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Just don't screw it up, you brats!」

stage0078_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Who do you think you're talking to?」

stage0078_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$レイ#333$$!
　Once this fight's over, I'll give you what I promised!」

stage0078_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Focus, Daddy's Boy, Teacher's Pet!
　The Angel's coming already!」

stage0078_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$スズネ$$
（All that's left is to make the operation a success.）

stage0078_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Five minutes until the Angel hits the surface!」

stage0078_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$マコト$$
「From that, we'll calculate the optimal
　standby points for the three EVAs!」

stage0078_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Transmit the data to all units!」

stage0078_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What?!
　This is right in the middle of the enemy!」

stage0078_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Skull Leader to all units!
　Our job's taking out the trash!」

stage0078_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Copy!
　That, we're used to!」

stage0078_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Not that I'm happy about it.」

stage0078_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All EVA units, break through the enemy
　and reach your assigned points
　within five minutes!」

stage0078_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Don't hold me back, Daddy's Boy, Teacher's Pet!」

stage0078_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Operation start!
　Good luck to every unit!」

stage0078_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Unit group approaching this area confirmed!
　This is... Geminis!」

stage0078_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$n
「$$ガドライト$$!
　Do you mean to get in our way?!」

stage0078_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$葵$$
「The Geminis lot don't care
　if the world ends, huh!」

stage0078_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Those who can't read the room like that...
　I'll have to ask them to leave...!」

stage0078_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$!
　We'll take care of them!」

stage0078_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$桂$$
「Don't worry about us,
　just focus on breaking through!」

stage0078_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Calculating the Angel's trajectory
　in real time...!
　We don't know what it'll do!」

stage0078_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ミサト$$
（Don't let your guard down, everyone.
　We still don't know what'll happen.）

stage0078_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$マコト$$
「All three EVAs are in position!」

stage0078_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$シゲル$$
「The Eighth Angel will soon enter
　the skies over $$第３新東京市$$!」

stage0078_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$マヤ$$
「The Angel is trying to change its trajectory!」

stage0078_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, pour every bit of firepower
　you can into the Angel!」

stage0078_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Even $c can't break through
　that A.T. Field...」

stage0078_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$, $$レイ#333$$!
　The Angel's coming!」

stage0078_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ミサト$$
「From here, I'm prioritizing your judgment!
　I'm staking everything on EVA and you three!」

stage0078_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Now's the time to make a miracle happen!」

stage0078_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But our ultimate goal is to intercept the Angel.
　It means nothing if EVA can't reach the point.」

stage0078_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ボビー$$
「$$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$, $$レイ#333$$!
　Hurry up!!」

stage0078_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$!
　Unit-01, stand by there!」

stage0078_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$レイ#333$$, stand by there!
　Watch for the enemy approaching!」

stage0078_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$アスカ$$, stand by at the point!
　Don't let your guard down!」

stage0078_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I know that without being told!」

stage0078_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$シゲル$$
「One minute until the Angel reaches the surface!」

stage0078_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, hurry!
　Reach your points within this one minute!」

stage0078_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$マコト$$
「It's no good!
　EVA won't make it in time!」

stage0078_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I have to do it...!
　I'm $c too!）

stage0078_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$アスカ$$
（I always thought I was alone, but...）

stage0078_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$アスカ$$
（Maybe this isn't so bad, after all.）

stage0078_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$甲児$$
「Do your best, $$シンジ$$, $$レイ#333$$, $$アスカ$$!」

stage0078_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$甲児$$
「Your senior's gonna carve the way open for you!」

stage0078_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Anyone who thinks it's fine if the world ends,
　get out of the way!」

stage0078_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$竹尾ワッ太$$ and EVA, comin' through!!」

stage0078_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$正太郎$$
「This operation needs all of $c's
　strength combined into one!」

stage0078_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do it, $$鉄人$$!
　If we protect $$シンジ$$ and the others,
　they're sure to protect the world!」

stage0078_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$竜馬$$
「The brats are fired up!
　Can't have the adults not risking their necks!」

stage0078_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Watch, $$シンジ$$!
　I'll show you how it's done!」

stage0078_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$葵$$
「Everyone putting their hearts together
　for one goal... Not bad at all.」

stage0078_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$葵$$
「Do your best, $$シンジ$$, $$レイ#333$$, $$アスカ$$!
　Big sis'll show you her serious side too!」

stage0078_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$タケル$$
「For the sake of every living person,
　we can't let this world end!」

stage0078_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$タケル$$
「I'm counting on you, $$シンジ$$, $$レイ#333$$, $$アスカ$$!
　I'm entrusting the world's future to you!」

stage0078_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Can't lose to him as his senior!
　I'll protect the peace as a salaryman,
　and with EVA!」

stage0078_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$シンジ$$, $$レイ#333$$, $$アスカ$$!
　I've felt your spirit too!」

stage0078_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$シモン$$
「Let's go!
　Anyone blocking EVA's path,
　my drill will punch through!」

stage0078_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$シンジ$$, $$レイ#333$$, $$アスカ$$...!
　I believe you'll make a miracle happen!」

stage0078_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「So we'll fight with everything we've got too!
　To make a miracle happen!!」

stage0078_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$アルト$$
「As club president, I'll look after my members!」

stage0078_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Go, $$シンジ$$, $$レイ#333$$, $$アスカ$$!
　We'll take on your enemies!」

stage0078_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$シンジ$$ and the others are risking
　their lives to make a miracle happen!」

stage0078_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「We'll fight too!
　To help $$シンジ$$ and the others
　make a miracle happen!!」

stage0078_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$桂$$
「It's a good thing, seeing kids
　give it their all!」

stage0078_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$桂$$
「Guess I've got no choice
　but to give it my all too!」

stage0078_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$バサラ$$
「All right, all right, you guys!
　Every last one of you's burning up!」

stage0078_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go, EVA!
　Listen to my song!!」

stage0078_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Normally, forcing my way through by strength
　wouldn't be my style.」

stage0078_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But to answer these kids' earnest feelings,
　I'll dare to bend $$ロジャー$$'s law today!」

stage0078_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$n
（I remember, $$シンジ$$.
　How you cheered me on
　as I chased after them.）

stage0078_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$n
（So today, I fight for you all!
　For my precious comrades!）
